sentences.text:
The petitioner is in custody in connection with ST Case No. 244 of 2023 arising out of Bagbera P.S.
Case No. 224 of 2022 under sections 323,420, 504, 376, 323, 415, 504, 376/34 of the IPC
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this is a case in which both the parties are husband and wife.
He has pointed out that at paragraph no.1 of the complaint the complainant herself admitted that the petitioner is her husband.
He further pointed out paragraph no.8 of the compliant in which it is stated that the petitioner used name of the complainant in various documents as his wife.
He further submitted that both the parties are major.

The learned counsel for the petitioner referred to exception 2 to section 375 IPC and submitted that sexual act by a man with his own wife not under fifteen years of age is not rape, therefore, the accused is not guilty of the offences alleged and he is in custody since 3.3.2023.
Therefore, he may be released on bail.
The learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail and submits that there are serious allegations against the petitioner.

Having heard learned counsels for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the petitioner, named above, on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-IV cum FTC (CAW) at Jamshedpur, in connection with ST Vinayak Das @ Binayak Das vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr ... ... ... on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178515125/

Case No. 224 of 2022, subject to the conditions that petitioner shall submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhar Card and mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of the case without prior permission of the Court.
